notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR4: data-name-1 to data-name-4 hold queue and sub-queue names that follow the system-name rules and "must have been previously defined to the message control system (MCS)". CommunicationArea.QueuePath reads positions 1-48, MessageDefinitions.FindQueue resolves them against mcs.json with McsNames' case fold (system-name rule), and an undefined or gapped path is status 20 in ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT, RECEIVE and ENABLE/DISABLE INPUT. Probes at 85 (series-of-data-names CD): a 4-level Q/A/B/C path counts 1; a gap at level 2, a leading space and a blank queue each 20; Q alone counts 2 and RECEIVE fills all four levels; lowercase a disables Q/A. Witness: PAYQ sub-queues known and unknown.

next.reason: 1985: "contain symbolic names designating queues, sub-queues, ... , respectively ... previously defined to the message control system (MCS)"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the communication description entry; no candidate covers queues or the MCS". The 2023 standard has no clause for the communication description entry, and no candidate deals with queues or the MCS. The communication feature is dropped.
